title: When Anonymity Breaks: Identifying Models Behind Text-to-Image Leaderboards

layout.note: Two regions side by side: the voting arena on the left (logo card, prompt, two images, prompt database, leaderboard icons) and a large red dashed frame on the right holding the pipeline. The adversary icon straddles the frame's left edge; the vote arrow loops back to the podium at top left.

lesson: Draw a threat model by putting the adversary icon on the border of a dashed frame that holds its pipeline, tie its actions to the victim system with dotted arrows, and end on the consequence (changed rankings on a podium). Show the key mechanism as a plain scatter whose colours match the sample stacks that produced it.
